C wf020.prompts-are-evidence OL WF-020 MUST ;; Use investigation prompts to look for evidence, not as automatic vulnerability declarations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-l1 EX WF-020,DEP-004 MUST ;; Supply-chain layer: review vulnerable direct/transitive dependencies, advisories, actual usage, patched compatible versions, untrusted NuGet sources; inspect npm audit distinguishing production vs dev and direct vs transitive; review lockfiles when integrity matters. ;; = ;; When the layer applies. ;; Per-layer scan coverage is investigation procedure beyond WF-020 (EXC-015).
C gov014.no-upgrade-during-scan OL GOV-014,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not upgrade packages during a scan unless asked. ;; = ;; When asked. ;;
C x.scan-l2 EX WF-020,SEC-001 MUST ;; Secrets/config layer: search .cs/.ts/.json/.yml/.yaml/.xml/.config/.env*/Dockerfiles/Compose/CI/scripts for real credentials; review production debug flags, certificate-validation bypass, credential-bearing URLs, verbose production errors and committed .env files. ;; = ;; none ;; Investigation coverage beyond the oracle (EXC-015).
C x.scan-l3 EX WF-020,SEC-003,SEC-004 MUST ;; Injection layer: look for SQL built from untrusted input, command execution with user input, path traversal, SSRF via user-controlled host/URL, Angular sanitizer bypasses/direct DOM with untrusted content, unsafe polymorphic deserialization. ;; = ;; none ;; Investigation coverage beyond the oracle (EXC-015).
C x.sec-command-exec EX SEC-003 PREFER ;; When command execution is genuinely needed prefer APIs separating executable and arguments and validate/constrain external input. ;; = ;; none ;; Command-injection engineering guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sec-path-boundary EX SEC-003 MUST ;; Normalize user-influenced paths and verify they remain within the intended storage boundary (incl. archive extraction). ;; = ;; none ;; Path-safety rule not in the oracle.
C x.sec-no-unsafe-deserialization EX SEC-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not deserialize untrusted payloads into arbitrary runtime types (e.g. BinaryFormatter, unsafe TypeNameHandling). ;; = ;; none ;; Deserialization prohibition not in the oracle.
C sec008.scan-crypto OL SEC-008,SEC-016 MUST ;; Flag security-sensitive MD5/SHA1/ECB, hardcoded keys, custom password hashing and home-grown encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.password-hashing OL SEC-016 MUST ;; Passwords use established one-way hashing facilities (e.g. Identity password hasher), not reversible encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.anonymous-intentional OL SEC-006,WF-020 MUST ;; Review [AllowAnonymous]/public surfaces to confirm public access is intentional; do not report every public endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-l4 EX WF-020,SEC-005 MUST ;; Access-control layer: look for identifier-only access to other users'/tenants' data (IDOR) and review password hashing, reset, lockout, enumeration and credential storage for local accounts. ;; = ;; none ;; Investigation coverage beyond the oracle (EXC-015).
C sec005.resource-ownership OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Verify ownership, tenant, permission or resource policy where required; client-side filtering is not authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.scan-validation OL SEC-017,WF-020 MUST ;; Check Bearer/OIDC validates issuer, audience where applicable, signing authority and lifetime; do not require manually setting every TokenValidationParameters property when authority metadata secures it, nor impose a universal ClockSkew; flag intentionally weakened validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.account-review OL SEC-016,SEC-018 MUST ;; For local accounts review password hashing, reset behaviour, lockout and account-enumeration behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.scan-cors OL SEC-009,SEC-005,WF-020 MUST ;; CORS is not authorization; check origins match the browser-client model (broad origins, credentialed untrusted origins, dev origins in Production); AllowAnyOrigin can be valid for public non-credentialed APIs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec011.scan-csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; With automatically sent browser credentials review CSRF protection for state-changing operations; Angular does not provide server-side CSRF protection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.scan-tls OL SEC-007,WF-020 MUST ;; Review disabled certificate validation, accept-all callbacks and plain HTTP for sensitive traffic, accounting for TLS termination topology. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-l5 EX WF-020,SEC-015 MUST ;; Upload layer: inspect size limits, storage path safety, file-name handling, content/type assumptions, execution/public-serving risks and authorization. ;; = ;; When uploads exist. ;; Investigation coverage beyond the oracle.
C x.scan-rate-limiting EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Consider rate limiting where abuse realistically matters (login, password reset, expensive anonymous/resource-intensive endpoints); do not require it on every endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;; Rate-limiting guidance not in the oracle.
C sec010.scan-logging OL SEC-010 MUST ;; Look for logged passwords, tokens, keys, auth secrets and payment credentials; review PII against requirements; Debug/Trace is not a security boundary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-l6 EX WF-020,ARC-029 MUST ;; Sensitive-data layer: review duplicate/missing security-relevant logging (without demanding logs for every request) and response data (entities returned directly, password hashes, security fields, unnecessary PII); explicit response contracts preferable where needed. ;; = ;; none ;; Investigation coverage beyond the oracle.
C sec008.match-protection OL SEC-008,SEC-016 MUST ;; Match data-at-rest protection to the requirement (password one-way hashing, verification tokens hashed, retrievable secrets protected storage, platform/database encryption, Data Protection for temporary payloads). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.scan-fail-open OL SEC-013 MUST ;; Investigate catches that let privileged operations continue after failures; security-relevant failures silently becoming success are findings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.scan-retries OL RUN-016 MUST ;; Review retries of state-changing operations for duplicate effects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-l7 EX WF-020,RUN-015 MUST ;; Exceptional-conditions layer: review operations/inputs that can consume unbounded time, memory, rows, file/body size, retries or parallel work. ;; = ;; none ;; Investigation coverage beyond the oracle.
C wf020.exploitability OL WF-020 MUST ;; A theoretical missing limit is not automatically High; evaluate whether an attacker can exploit it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec014.scan-startup-fallback OL SEC-014 MUST ;; Look for dangerous fallbacks in security-sensitive startup configuration (auth silently disabled, plaintext mode, allow-all). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.scan-central-errors OL API-007,API-008 MUST ;; Confirm unexpected exceptions follow centralized error handling and reveal no sensitive information. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-design-review EX WF-020 MUST ;; Identify meaningful security-sensitive workflows (insecure design, tenant isolation, workflow abuse, privilege escalation, idempotency abuse, multi-step authorization) as candidates for threat modeling/manual review instead of claiming the static scan proves them secure. ;; = ;; When such workflows exist. ;; Design-review escalation obligation not in the oracle.
C wf020.no-mechanical-severity OL WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not mechanically map pattern, CVSS or OWASP category to severity. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.no-invented-exploitability OL WF-012,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not invent exploitability that the code does not establish. ;; = ;; none ;;
